headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 13, 2026**
article:
The Miami Marlins secured a crucial 8-3 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Liam Hicks leading the offense. Sandy Alcantara pitched 8 strong innings, striking out 7 and allowing 3 earned runs. In other news, the Seattle Mariners dominated the Washington Nationals 10-2 behind a strong performance from their pitching staff, while the Baltimore Orioles secured a 7-3 victory over the San Diego Padres.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, with the New York Yankees placing center fielder Trent Grisham on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain. The Atlanta Braves have also placed right-hander Spencer Strider on the 15-day injured list with right elbow inflammation. Other teams have also suffered injuries, including the Milwaukee Brewers, Colorado Rockies, Kansas City Royals, Athletics, St. Louis Cardinals, and Philadelphia Phillies.

The Chicago White Sox have made a significant move, acquiring outfielder Nolan Jones from the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for future considerations. The Detroit Tigers have also made a trade, acquiring right-hander Jacob Waguespack from the Milwaukee Brewers.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Pirates 8-3**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured an 8-3 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Liam Hicks leading the offense. Sandy Alcantara pitched 8 strong innings, striking out 7 and allowing 3 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Mariners Cruise Past Nationals 10-2**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners dominated the Washington Nationals, securing a 10-2 victory behind a strong performance from their pitching staff. Bryce Miller led the way with 8.0 innings pitched, 7 strikeouts, and 2 earned runs allowed.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall to Orioles in 7-3 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 7-3 victory over the San Diego Padres, with Gunnar Henderson leading the Orioles' offense with 3 hits, including a home run, and 1 RBI. Shane Baz earned the win for the Orioles.

top_news.title: **Tigers Fall Short in Cleveland**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers dropped a 2-3 decision to the Cleveland Guardians in their latest matchup. Spencer Torkelson led the Tigers' offense with a home run and an RBI, while Tanner Bibee earned the win for the Guardians with 7 strong innings.

top_news.title: **Yankees Place Trent Grisham on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Trent Grisham, the center fielder for the New York Yankees, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain.

top_news.title: **White Sox Acquire Nolan Jones in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox have made a move to bolster their roster, acquiring outfielder Nolan Jones from the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for future considerations.
